facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.create_multi_spkr_multi_style_dataset: create a MultiSpkrMultiStyleCodeDataset to load training audio files with speaker and style labels for speech resynthesis

facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.run_inference_multigpu: run multi-GPU parallel inference to synthesize speech from a dataset of discrete codes
facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.run_inference_debug: run single-GPU debug inference to generate speech audio from one item at a time

facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.test_upsample_static_method: test the _upsample static method to repeat condition signals across the time dimension

facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.run_train_validation: run training with periodic validation that logs generated audio and spectrograms to TensorBoard
facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.run_train_fine_tuning: run fine-tuning of the Expresso vocoder model by passing the fine_tuning flag and config file
facebookresearch_speech-resynthesis/exam.run_train_checkpoint_resume: run training that automatically resumes from the latest generator and discriminator checkpoints in the checkpoint directory
